Russia possesses 19 Uranium to Germany's 3 and maintains 4.6x military superiority (15440 vs 3335). Without strategic resource parity, Germany cannot build sufficient nuclear deterrent or air/armored forces to resist Russian expansion. The 25% maintenance reduction is also vital given Germany's thin +10 GPT margin versus Russia's catastrophic -458 GPT (which may eventually collapse their economy, but not before they attack). Domination and Diplomatic victories are impossible given Russia's strength and Greece's 25 World Congress delegates respectively. Science Victory is Germany's only realistic path. Current Computers research finishes in ~13 turns; Satellites must follow immediately to begin Apollo Program construction before India's cultural victory or Russian military collapse of Germany's empire.
